purpose: Prove coherent fixed-anchor effects using one model keyframe and deterministic animation transforms.

style.perspective: strict side view, effect travels or emits toward the right

frames.prompt: Create one original isolated pixel-art Arc Launcher projectile sprite, strict side view travelling right. A compact elongated cyan plasma core with a restrained violet electrical halo and two short trailing sparks, readable at 48x24 pixels. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients, no antialiasing, no weapon, no character, no text, no shadow, no floor, no border, and no other objects. Center the projectile. Use only dark gunmetal, cyan, violet, pale blue, and white. The entire background, including every enclosed empty area, must be a perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00 chroma field.

Create the peak keyframe of one original isolated pixel-art Arc Launcher muzzle flash, strict side view emitting only toward the right. Draw a wide horizontal cyan-white electrical cone or branching wedge that begins at one narrow attachment point on the exact left-center edge and expands rightward. The overall silhouette must be at least twice as wide as it is tall. Add restrained violet branches. Do not draw a circular explosion, ring, orb, projectile, weapon, character, text, shadow, floor, border, or other object. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients and no antialiasing. Keep it fully inside the canvas. The entire background and every enclosed empty area must be perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00.

Create the peak keyframe of one original isolated stationary pixel-art Arc projectile impact. Draw one centered circular cyan-white electrical burst with a readable violet energy ring and several short radial sparks. It must be symmetrical enough to scale around the exact canvas center and must not imply travel on x or y. Do not draw a projectile, weapon, character, surface, text, shadow, floor, border, or other object. Use crisp hard pixel clusters, no gradients and no antialiasing. Keep it fully inside the canvas. The entire background and every enclosed empty area must be perfectly flat solid pure green #00ff00.
